fields.name: AADT
fields.description: {"value":"Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) measures the total volume of vehicle traffic on a road segment over an entire year divided by the number of days in that year. It represents the typical daily traffic load on all lanes in both directions, while evening out seasonal spikes and weekend fluctuations. Historical AADT values are adjusted annually (during non-collection years) to represent current year data.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: AADT_SINGLE_UNIT
fields.alias: Single-Unit Truck and Bus Annual Average Daily Traffic
fields.description: {"value":"Annual Average Daily Traffic for single-unit trucks and buses (FHWA vehicle classes 4-7: buses through four-or-more axle, single-unit trucks). Historical AADT values are adjusted annually (during non-collection years) to represent current year data.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: AADT_COMBINATION
fields.alias: Combination Truck Annual Average Daily Traffic
fields.description: {"value":"Annual Average Daily Traffic for Combination Trucks (FHWA vehicle classes 8-13: four-or-less axle, single-trailer trucks through seven-or-more axle, multi- trailer trucks). Historical AADT values are adjusted annually (during non-collection years) to represent current year data.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

codedValues.name: Principal Arterial - Other Freeways and Expressways

fields.name: RouteName
fields.description: {"value":" A familiar, non-numeric designation for a route.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: RouteNumber
fields.description: {"value":"The signed route number. This number is based on the primary route (as defined by the HPMS Field Manual) for concurrent routes. Can be used along with route signing and route qualifier to track information by specific route.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: THROUGH_LANES
fields.description: {"value":"The number of lanes designated for through-traffic in both directions in the off-peak period.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: DATA_YEAR
fields.description: {"value":"The calendar year for which the data are being reported.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}
